THE OPEN SEGMENT AT DESTINATION HAS NO RESTRICTIONS

PERMITTED. MILEAGE OF THE OPEN SEGMENT MUST BE EQUAL/
LESS THAN MILEAGE OF THE LONGEST FLOWN FARE
COMPONENT.

PROVIDED -

OR FOR CARRIER WF/LH/LO

TARIFF.

PERMITTED WITH NO RESTRICTIONS.
